import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(top_breeds))
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()
age_data = age_data[age_data <= 20]  # Remove outliers
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = plt.cm.viridis(range(len(district_counts)))
district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Population by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Dog Gender vs Owner Gender Heatmap
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'], normalize='index') * 100
sns.heatmap(gender_cross, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax4, 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Percentage (%)'}, linewidths=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender (%)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_yticklabels(ax4.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
